role: Soul sand (id 88): a full block whose collision box is 0.875 high and that halves the horizontal motion of entities standing in it.

members.name: BlockSoulSand
members.note: id 88: Material.sand row and static bounds in the table

members.name: onEntityCollidedWithBlock
members.note: case 88 returns COLLIDE_EFFECT_SOUL_SAND; the movement code damps motionX/Z by 0.4 (collide.h documents the contract)

notes: No recording or test was found that walks on soul sand, so the damping is verified only by reading collide.c and the movement code that consumes the effect. The wither build on soul sand lives in BlockSkull.func_149965_a and is dead under world.conf wither = off.
